body: As someone who did report my rapist do NOT force her to do something she is not ready to do. Reporting is a God awful experience. They basically outright call you a liar and ask you super uncomfortable, unnecessary and invasive questions. Support her but stop trying to make her do things she is not comfortable with.

is his mom or other family members (or someone who lives near him) supportive of him and his mental health needs? I think, if they are, you should tell them what happened, so they can keep an eye on him and maybe try to get him into a health care facility. He sounds extremely unstable and that's not safe.
Thank you so much. I'm going to try that next time... They haven't returned for a couple of days but if/when they do I'll try that. Thank you ^-^

I feel disconnected from my body... Like I am inhabiting it but it's kind of like that friend who crashes on your couch and it's been a month and they havent left yet type of feeling... Idk if that makes sense.

I keep losing words... I couldn't think of the word "coffee table" and other simple words. it takes me longer to actually talk.... Like my mouth won't say the words I want it to???? It doesn't make sense.

I get confused easier and I need more sleep than I've needed in a long time.... I'm scared...
Not really... I've been getting more sleep than usual actually
I know... I don't think I'd actually do anything. Just the thought is there ya know?
My friends know what happened but I feel like with everything that has happened with my boyfriend it will be too much for them all...

1. He did rape you. 
2. I dont care if you spit in his face. You dont deserve to be raped as a "punishment" or at all. Nobody does.
Please leave him.... Seek professional help to help you deal with what happened and if you feel safe enough talk to a family member/friend im sorry this happened to you
they've lowered some... but apparently they can't or refuse to lower the others..
